summary: Executed focused backend+frontend regression for game entry freeze/tier KeyError scope. Backend suites passed (27/27) including new tier normalization, market pack grant idempotency (offline + live apply), snapshot safety, failing-player snapshot isolation, and real external SIWE + paid-entitlement /api/join+WS rejoin flow. Frontend smoke confirms / -> /loadout navigation and no horizontal overflow on desktop/mobile, but full wallet-driven in-browser join/failure-simulation scenarios were not fully automatable in this run.

critical.issue: New backend.err.log entries during this run show unhandled asyncio task exceptions: RuntimeError('progress_revision_conflict') from save_in_order(). This can produce noisy logs and indicates stale revision races on reconnect/disconnect persistence.

integration_issues.flow: Controlled frontend failure scenarios in-browser (no state 15s, stalled /join abort race, audio init reject, timer/worker teardown) with real wallet/session
integration_issues.issue: Not fully executed end-to-end in browser automation due absence of controlled injected EIP1193 wallet/session orchestration in this run. Backend equivalent /join+WS real flow verified externally via SIWE + test-only entitlement.

action_items: Handle progress_revision_conflict in Game.persist_progress task chain (catch/suppress expected CAS races and/or rebase+retry) to prevent unhandled task exceptions in backend.err.log.

Add deterministic frontend tests for useSession controlled failures with explicit MOCKED worker/socket/EIP1193 wallet harness (state-timeout, stalled join abort, delayed first state, no-state-after-playing, audio init rejection, teardown on leave/unmount).
Run final browser gameplay pass with controlled wallet injection to validate HUD transition from CONNECTING only on first state in UI layer (backend path already validated).
critical_code_review_comments: Tier-safe snapshot path is now robust in tests: legacy/missing tier records no longer crash snapshot serialization, and unknown records remain non-destructively preserved.
Market pack grants are idempotent across offline fulfillment and live apply path; second application does not duplicate grants.
Persistence CAS race still leaks as unhandled async task exception in runtime logs; this should be normalized as an expected conflict path rather than logged as task failure.

success_rate.frontend: 60% (smoke/navigation/responsive checks passed; advanced controlled-failure wallet flows partially covered)

test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md guidance. No static player credentials used; disposable SIWE wallets generated via eth_account.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST-ONLY access entitlement + auth/account/progress/session/order records for disposable wallets in preview Mongo. Cleanup executed and sync_db_to_file(db) called post-cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression coverage for tier freeze root-cause area is now strong and green. Reproduce remaining log issue by doing rapid join/leave/rejoin with same account and inspect backend.err.log for progress_revision_conflict task exception. Frontend controlled failure matrix still needs dedicated MOCKED wallet+worker harness to fully assert useSession timers/abort guards in browser-visible flow.
rca of the issue: Observed new runtime error after test start: unhandled Task exception in Game.persist_progress.save_in_order when save_player_progress raises progress_revision_conflict (stale revision under reconnect/disconnect race). Reproduction signal: join websocket, disconnect/rejoin quickly with same account, then persistence tail may attempt stale CAS write. Mitigation: treat revision conflict as expected concurrency event in save_in_order (catch + optional latest-progress rebase/retry) and avoid leaving task exception unhandled in event loop.
